valuePrompt: Which of these two matters more to you?

values.label: Freedom to do things my way
Being liked and accepted by others

questions.prompt: When life changes, what helps you more?

choices.label: Taking one small, steady step
Waiting until everything is under control

questions.prompt: When daily stress grows, what do you usually do?

choices.label: Pause, calm down, then continue slowly
Keep reacting until the stress is over

questions.prompt: When your daily routine changes, what matters more to you?

choices.label: A stable base that can still change
Keeping the routine exactly the same

questions.prompt: When the future is unclear, what do you do?

choices.label: Focus on what I can do today
Keep looking for every possible risk

questions.prompt: Which is closer to how you enjoy things?

choices.label: I can stop when I feel satisfied
I always need more to feel satisfied

questions.prompt: When you have strong feelings, what do you usually do?

choices.label: Notice them and share them calmly
Push them away until they go

questions.prompt: How do you like to be creative?

choices.label: Try things, even if the result is not perfect
Create only when the result proves something

questions.prompt: In a close relationship, what matters more to you?

choices.label: Being close and still being myself
Giving up my own space to stay close

questions.prompt: When you make a decision, what do you usually do?

choices.label: Decide myself and listen to good advice
Wait for someone else to decide

questions.prompt: When something might not work, what do you do?

choices.label: Try my best and learn from it
Not start unless success is sure

questions.prompt: How do you usually set limits with people?

choices.label: Clear limits, with room to talk
Say yes even when my needs are ignored

questions.prompt: What drives you to work hard?

choices.label: A purpose, with time left for life
Proving that I am good enough

questions.prompt: When you care for someone, what is closer to you?

choices.label: I help and still look after myself
I forget my own needs so they never struggle

questions.prompt: When someone praises you, what do you do?

choices.label: Accept it and feel fine without it too
Doubt it or push it away

questions.prompt: After someone hurts your feelings, what do you do?

choices.label: Heal slowly and keep healthy limits
Shut people out so I never get hurt again

questions.prompt: When someone needs help, what is closer to you?

choices.label: Help as much as I really can
Take full responsibility for fixing their problem

questions.prompt: When someone asks what you want, what do you do?

choices.label: Say it clearly and talk about it
Keep it to myself, even when it matters

questions.prompt: When you disagree with someone, what do you do?

choices.label: Share my view and listen to theirs
Keep talking until they stop

questions.prompt: When you need to say no, what do you do?

choices.label: Say no clearly and calmly
Say yes now and feel upset later

questions.prompt: When another person is talking, what do you do?

choices.label: Listen fully, then think of my reply
Plan my reply while they are still talking

questions.prompt: Before you decide something important, what do you do?

choices.label: Use my feeling and check the facts
Go with my first idea

questions.prompt: How do you use your inner feeling (intuition)?

choices.label: I listen to it and check if it is true
I believe it is always right

questions.prompt: When someone sees things differently, what do you do?

choices.label: Think about it and keep my own view in mind
Reject it before I think about it

questions.prompt: How do you use your imagination?

choices.label: To explore ideas and stay practical
To escape from choices I need to make now

questions.prompt: How do you feel about the meaning of life?

choices.label: Life has meaning, even without all the answers
I need one clear answer for everything

questions.prompt: How should meditation fit into your daily life?

choices.label: It should help my work and my relationships
It should take me away from hard daily duties

questions.prompt: When there is no clear answer yet, what do you do?

choices.label: Stay open and keep going
Take the first answer that ends the doubt

questions.prompt: How do you feel about being part of something bigger?

choices.label: I feel part of it and I am still myself
That idea decides every choice I make
